title: Stand four dominoes on end on marks and tip the first to topple the chain
instruction: Stand the four dominoes on end on the white marks 30 mm apart, then tip the first one so every domino falls.
setup: Four dominoes (20 x 40 x 70 mm tall when standing, mass 0.02 kg, friction 0.45, orange/blue/yellow/green) start lying flat on table. Four white marks 20x40 mm in a row along x at x = 0.26, 0.31, 0.36, 0.41, y = 0.0 (50 mm pitch, 30 mm gap). Left arm places 2 dominoes, Right arm places 2 dominoes.
context: Automated precision component standing, delicate part placing, sequenced domino dynamics.
scoring: Ladder: 0.25 for two dominoes standing on end on marks; 0.50 for all four dominoes standing on end on marks; 0.75 for first domino tipped (tilt > 20 deg) while others standing; 1.00 for all four dominoes fallen toward +x within 5.0 s of tip with arms clear (> 60 mm). Zero-gate: any domino falling (tilt > 45 deg) before all four are standing marks premature, capping score at 0.25 max.
fidelity: Rigid body PhysX dynamics with realistic friction (0.45), exact domino geometry (20x40x70 mm, 0.02 kg) and pitch spacing (50 mm pitch, 30 mm gap), delicate parallel-jaw placement, toppling collision impulse dynamics, and bimanual arm reach envelopes without simulated sensory shortcuts.
reset_notes: Dominoes reset to initial positions flat on table, grippers open at home stance.
